description:
Rollup for Group A: the direct, single-landing replacement of the repository mutation architecture. One landing replaces declarations, capture, materialization, managed documents, typed serialization/audit, storage publication, every repository-owned mutation consumer, and every predecessor path.

## Background

The repository-materialization consolidation is delivered as five cumulative, final-form work packages on branch `integration/cdc840ad` followed by one rebased/gated integration leaf that merges the complete stack to main. This story groups that Group A work and asserts the staging discipline that keeps it a single product transition. Its child work carries the implementation; this rollup holds the branch-discipline outcome.

## What to build

- The complete Group A outcome: final declaration owners; canonical layout/image/capture with physical-identity uniqueness; pinned and linked-worktree evidence; typed intents/deltas; the strict managed-document engine; the layout-aware recovered store, kernel, staged absent-root publication, and `DeleteFile`; typed mutation, exact lifecycle time/ID authority, and canonical audit append; claim's repository-side synchronization under coordinator → bootstrap → repository → events; the materializers, drift, and ownership-safe repair; and the full consumer migration with every predecessor deleted — all accumulated on the integration branch and landed as one reviewed transition.
- Enforce the staging discipline: work packages commit cumulative, final-form code only to `integration/cdc840ad`; they are never merged to main individually; predecessor deletion completes in the final work package before integration; neither integration nor assurance defers cleanup.

Distilled §2 contracts: research-to-final vocabulary and staged one-landing execution. See `dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md` §2, §3 (Group A), and §4, and plan decisions D10, D16 for full detail.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No Group A package merges to main; the final integration is the only product transition.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every commit on the integration branch contains only final-form code and passes the full test suite of every crate it touches; all predecessor deletion completes on the branch before the final integration merge; no cleanup is deferred past that merge.

## Constraints

- One dedicated worktree on branch `integration/cdc840ad`; cumulative final-form commits only; no independent main merge of any package.
- No adapter, feature flag, compatibility re-export, dual path, or temporary API is introduced at any staging step.
- Out of scope (plan D19/D20): lease credential/claim-log/claim-command redesign and worktree/data-root binding redesign.

Blast radius: the complete declarations/repository_state/validation/profile/storage/command/CLI/server/MCP/script/test inventory in §2.
